content: Standard client for Spring STOMP-over-WebSocket from React in 2025/2026 is @stomp/stompjs (the modern, actively maintained STOMP JS client). sockjs-client is only needed as an HTTP-polling fallback for browsers without native WebSocket support and is unnecessary for a modern-browser-only target; @stomp/stompjs can connect directly to a ws:// endpoint without SockJS.
